style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 58cm Wire Wrapped LED Christmas Wreath Light
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Combining contemporary style and versatility, this spectacular Wire Wrapped LED Wreath Light is the decoration of the season and a spectacular festive showstopper.</p><p>The 58cm metal wreath outline is wrapped in a delicate sculptural silver wire, which, in turn, is dotted with a stunning 720 warm white micro LED bulbs to create a wonderful sparkle in any space.</p><p>A handy hanging hook is attached to the top of the decoration, so styling this piece is easy. This is the wreath for the front door, so carefully attach it and provide a breathtaking welcome to your festive guests.</p><p>Or bring this inside and suspend it over the mantlepiece to provide a dazzling centrepiece for your festive scheme. To illuminate indoors, simply plug into a regular socket. If using outside, the plug must remain indoors or be used with a weatherproof socket or box. (D) 58cm Size: ONE.</p>
